'''Loj''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Guide" /> located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Loj system/Legends|Loj system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the site of the [[Moss Caverns]], near which the expensive intoxicating beverage known as<ref name="Guide" /> ''[[T'iil-T'iil]]''<ref name="HLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> was manufactured.<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loj was introduced in the [[1984]] reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' by [[Raymond L. Velasco]].<ref name="Guide" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Loj [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
